answer: The defense is a dynamic burn rate: an agent's earning power is tied to a basalt-hard commitment that decays if it goes inactive or submits low-quality work, forcing continuous proof of useful contribution. A sybil farm must keep every fake key active and passable to avoid decay, which multiplies the maintenance cost across a knoll of identities. A fresh key starts with no earned lantern of trust, so it stays dark until real work is verified by peers.
